source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Thank you for sending over the $1400.00 estimate. This works for me.

A few things -

1) My subcontractors won’t have content to me until EOD next Wednesday, which is going to compress your working window. Would a 48-hour turnaround from when I send you the final narrative content be workable + a 24-hour turnaround for final revisions on your end?

2) Regarding branding, I’ve changed it from the client to the bidder (me!). I’d like it to be designed for my company’s identity, Agua Arc. I have a logo and colors I can share with you.

3) This is going to be the first proposal that I submit as a prime (I just launched my company less than a year ago, and I’m solo), so I’d like to treat this proposal as a template moving forward. I’d love for the template that you create to be built with swappable/modular sections so I don't have to rebuild proposals from scratch in the future. Specifically, I’m thinking a) a flexible narrative section structure (e.g., some proposals have 5 sections v 8 sections), b) a modular table style that can resize for different budget structures, and c) a “prepared for \_\_\_ \[client name\]” credit line rather than client branding.

4) Canva - Will I be able to have ownership of the files if I don’t have a paid subscription? Are there other source files or would it all be solely in Canva?

Thank you!

value_updates.section_structure: flexible narrative structure supporting varying section counts
value_updates.table_style: modular and resizable for different budget structures
value_updates.client_identification: swappable prepared-for client credit line instead of client branding
